name: Open_Window_Library_1
description:
The atmosphere of a school library, with hushed whispers, the soft rustling of turning pages, and the occasional creak of chairs, was recorded. Captured in high-quality stereo using a ZOOM H6 handheld recorder with its XY capsule microphone. Post-production included eliminating any distracting noise. This audio captures the essence of a school library and is perfect for enhancing audio-visual projects, educational scenes, or any creative work set in a tranquil library environment.
Recorded at the Open Window Library.
